name: Roll A Friend [2 Player Obby]
desc:
🎳 Choose between being a pusher or a ball as you roll your way through this fun obby! Work together to overcome wild obstacles and really test the power of your friendship.

💥 Tap, launch, and spin your friends using the in-game troll menu!

Will you be able to reach the end line safely or will you be thrown off the map?

The delay? Make A FREE PRIVATE SERVER!

If you find a mistake, let us know!
